delightful_compat.jei.sweet_potato: Sweet Potato has been unified by Delightful Compat. Peruvian's Delight (camote) and Veggies Delight both add a sweet potato; they share the c:crops/sweet_potato and c:foods/sweet_potato tags so recipes accept either, and this pack standardizes the output to Peruvian's Delight camote. Add more variants to the tags.
delightful_compat.jei.dough: Dough has been unified by Delightful Compat. Farmer's Delight Wheat Dough and Ramadan Delight Small Dough are both members of c:foods/dough, so dough-based recipes accept either. To avoid an item-duplication loop, the 'small dough from dough' crafting recipe was moved to the Cutting Board.
delightful_compat.jei.milk: Milk has been unified by Delightful Compat. The Farmer's Delight Milk Bottle and the vanilla Milk Bucket both count as 'milk' (c:foods/milk and c:drinks/milk), so milk recipes work even if you only have buckets. If no milk-bottle item is installed, a milk-bucket cake recipe is provided as a fallback.
delightful_compat.jei.mashed_potatoes: Mashed Potatoes has been unified by Delightful Compat. More Delight, Slavic Delight and Veggies Delight each add their own Mashed Potatoes; they are grouped under c:foods/mashed_potatoes and this pack standardizes on the More Delight version. The duplicates are hidden from JEI.
delightful_compat.jei.pancakes: Pancakes has been unified by Delightful Compat. Oaks Delight and Slavic Delight each add their own Pancakes; they are grouped under c:foods/pancakes and this pack standardizes on the Oaks Delight version. The duplicate is hidden from JEI.
delightful_compat.jei.toast: Toast has been unified by Delightful Compat. Oak's Delight, More Delight and My Nether's Delight each add a Toast; they share the c:foods/toast tag and every toast-consuming recipe (toast with egg, cheese, honey, …) was overridden to read that tag, so any toast works anywhere. Recipes that produce a non-canonical toast are standardized to Oak's Delight toast, and the duplicates are hidden from JEI.
